results.message: Since it's just past 12:30am, you're in luck: Bacha Coffee is open until 1am, and Starbucks and The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf are both open 24/7. Bacha is the showpiece, with over 200 Arabica coffees under Moroccan stained-glass ceilings, but it's takeaway only, so take your cup to the gate. If you'd rather sit down, Starbucks has counter seats facing the atrium glass, and Coffee Bean is usually quieter with good terminal views. With 75 usable minutes you have plenty of time for any of them, though Bacha closes soon, so I'd go there first if it appeals.

results.message: At 12:34 am, the Snooze Lounge in T1 is your best bet. It's free, open 24/7 and needs no booking, with reclining chairs, dimmed lighting, a quiet zone and a small privacy screen at each chair. It's first-come-first-served, so it may be busy, but the late-night hours (11pm to 6am) are when it works best. With about 4 hours to boarding, you have room for a proper rest. If you want a real bed, Crowne Plaza is connected to T1 and offers day-use rooms, though it's worth checking availability this late. The Ambassador Transit Hotel is another option, but its listed hours end at 23:00, so confirm at the desk. I'd set an alarm for about 90 minutes before boarding so you don't oversleep.

results.message: For proper local flavours in T2, the Heavenly Wang kopitiam is a great pick: real Singapore kopi, kaya toast and a solid, affordable Nasi Lemak set, and it's open 24/7, which suits this late hour. The T2 Food Gallery is also open around the clock and gives you hawker-style stalls under one roof, so you can try Hainanese chicken rice, laksa or nasi lemak. If you just want a quick bite, Old Chang Kee's curry puff is the classic local snack, though it's closed at this hour (opens 08:00). The dnata Lounge is worth a look if you've got a long wait ahead, and its nasi lemak gets good reviews, but it's closed until 06:00.

Note that it's just past midnight, so check opening hours at the venue for anything not listed as 24/7, though these shops are listed as open now.
